program.name: Grip EMOM
program.subject: Grip & forearms
program.blurb: Grip on the minute: holds, carries and curls in an EMOM, then forearm supersets.
program.about: Grip strength on the clock. One day is an EMOM of farmer carries, dead hangs, shrug holds and wrist curls, a set at the top of every minute. The other day is forearm supersets, wrist curls with reverse curls and hammer curls with Zottman curls. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and time and Level III asks for heavier weights.
